items.name: Quotas & cost
items.text: Handle quotas via backoff, SQS/Map concurrency caps, or batch jobs. Cut token cost with lean prompts, caching, and incremental runs.

items.name: Validation & audit
items.text: Request JSON output, validate with schema and Glue DQ rules, and route failures to review. Log model ID, prompt version, and timestamp.

items.name: Security & privacy
items.text: Bedrock never trains base models on your prompts. Use PrivateLink endpoints, model-ARN IAM, KMS, and PII masking or Guardrails.

blocks.heading: Exam tips & traps
items: Choose managed Bedrock APIs over training, fine-tuning, or self-hosting LLMs on EC2 GPUs (distractors).
Always validate LLM JSON outputs with schema or DQ checks before writing to trusted tables.
Fix Bedrock throttling via backoff/retries, concurrency limits (SQS/Map), or batch inference.
Protect PII with PrivateLink endpoints, least-privilege IAM, and upstream masking or Guardrails.

blocks.caption: Managed API access to foundation models; pair sync/batch inference with Step Functions, RAG & Guardrails.
